summary: Scope: source contract, not a provisioned runner, registration or dispatch authority. Supersedes the org runner-group route (group fsgg-native-qualification, selected workflows). The org is on GitHub Free, so restricted groups cannot exist; Root decided (FS-GG/.github#4778) on a repository-level ephemeral JIT runner in group Default of the PRIVATE repo FS-GG/FS.GG.Native.Qualification, runner names fsgg-q-*, label fsgg-native-linux-x64-v1, public repositories never enabled. The reviewed source of truth for that repo's dispatch-only caller is deployment/qualification-runner/native-qualification/ in Coordination (workflow, README, actionlint config pinned by MANIFEST.sha256; the private repo holds byte-identical copies); it is deliberately outside .github/workflows so public Coordination can never queue it and no Coordination workflow or actionlint label targets the runner. Caller guards: job skipped unless refs/heads/main and attempt 1; first step checks group Default, fsgg-q- name, native job record and the 300 s Root clock; a plain unprivileged step requires the explicit coordination_sha to be an ancestor of Coordination main and the caller files to equal the template before pinned-source code runs as root; the always-run receipt step refuses unless that guard passed. These guards live in the workflow, so they bind only an unmodified caller. Branch protection and rulesets are unavailable for private repos on Free (HTTP 403); Root accepted compensating controls: GitHub-owned actions only with SHA pinning, fork-PR workflows off, read-only default token, two admin collaborators, and Home's host-side assignment guard as the binding fence. eng/bar_hosted_operation.py takes the source revision from the pinned Coordination SHA and the native job head from the caller commit. Qualified-image layer: provision-image.sh bakes once, guest-boot.sh binds per boot, run-jit-runner.sh starts one JIT job, dedicated_qualification_runner.py verify-guest reads it back. Merged by Coordination #1066 (ff4a54a8) and Native.Qualification #1 (c937c2ce). Open: image identity pins DEDICATED_IMAGE_SHA256/DEDICATED_PROVIDER_IMAGE_ID unset; JIT runner self-update, runuser environment and repo-level runner_group_name readback unverified until the first guest rehearsal.
title: Dedicated qualification runner serves one private caller repository (GitHub Free route)
